authority: User-requested nominal CAD fit adjustment. The 1.25 mm values are total diameter/gap reductions, not per-side or radius changes.
interpretation: Move the two compliant gripping faces 0.625 mm inward per side and reduce the circular upright aperture radius by 0.625 mm per side.
excluded_claims: The requested reductions do not measure the production antenna.
